candidates: A_prod: production sequential scan (fp32 store; deployed bf16 store reported)
B_fs[ieee]: ancestor-masked triangular solve (forward substitution) + compact reconstruction, fp32 ieee (bf16-store variant reported)
C_nm[ieee]: Bole finite-Neumann (d terms) + compact reconstruction, fp32 ieee (bf16-store variant reported)
excluded: B_fs[tf32], C_nm[tf32]: 3–4 orders worse on all 8 pilot sets (out32 vs oracle max 1.34e-4 vs 4.45e-8); reported as ablation only, never promoted
A_legacy (June-8 vendored scan export skips the root update; source-inspected), B_legacyWY bf16-bnd: excluded as before
detail.rationale: Pilot (8 VERIFIED-FRESH sets, out-20260922T012554Z-e7a-fresh-pilot): A_prod fp32 out bit-identical to the pinned native spec-update kernel on 8/8 (integer view, fp32 and bf16 stores); B/C fp32-ieee out vs fp64 oracle ≤ 4.447e-08 (A ≤ 2.724e-08); compact-commit state vs oracle ≤ 7.867e-07; bf16-store B/C agreement with native ≥ 0.999788; sibling-reorder and padding controls bitwise-invariant on 8/8; replay repeat-launch bitwise-equal on 8/8. Served output (live server, tree step 1) byte-identical to the production scan and native spec-update bf16 outputs on 8/8 (fresh-pilot-v2).

scan_fp32_out_vs_native_specupdate_bitwi.rule: 0 ULP, integer view (bit-identical), production scan fp32 store vs pinned native spec-update kernel; pilot 8/8 bitwise_frac = 1.0

scan_bf16_out_vs_native_specupdate_bitwi.rule: 0 ULP, integer view, deployed bf16 store vs native spec-update bf16 store; pilot 8/8 bitwise_frac = 1.0

detail: any confirmation set where the production-scan fp32 or bf16 store is not bit-identical (integer view) to the pinned native spec-update kernel
any confirmation set where the payload's served bf16 output is not byte-identical to the production scan bf16 output (and to the native spec-update bf16 output) on the captured operands
any confirmation set where a candidate's fp32-ieee out vs fp64 oracle, compact-commit state vs oracle/native, or replay state exceeds its frozen tolerance
bf16-store B/C disagreement with native above the frozen class (agreement floor 0.999683) on any confirmation set
served bf16 output vs fp64 oracle > 1 ULP16 on significant elements or above the frozen max-abs class on any confirmation set

detail.basis: half-width = (p90 - p10) / (2 * median) of CUDA-event sync timings, iters 200 / warmup 20, per set. Applies to the VERIFY-class kernels (A_prod scan out16, B_fs/C_nm verify out16, native spec-update chain): pilot max 0.0623 (met). COMMIT-class kernels (~18–105 us: B/C compact commit, A replay commit, native one-token) are REPORTED, not gated: pilot half-width max 0.216 on 3/8 sets exceeded 0.05 because of sub-20-us jitter; confirmation rows above 0.05 are labeled imprecise. Probe drift pilot max 0.0370. Timing remains a shared-device diagnostic; attribution label required per run.

resampling_unit_is_prefix.detail: frozen prefix (one boot, one request, one one-shot payload per prefix; never layer/file/row)
